scenarios.behaviour: Clicking 'Place order' twice in quick succession creates one order.
scenarios.sourceNote: Suspected eShop bug. The checkout form makes a RequestId for idempotency (src/WebApp/Components/Pages/Checkout/Checkout.razor:94) and the API ignores a repeated one (src/Ordering.API/Application/Commands/IdentifiedCommandHandler.cs:275-279), but the form has no field for it, so each post binds an empty id and src/WebApp/Services/BasketState.cs:80-83 makes a new one. Two posts that both pass the empty-bag check (Checkout.razor:122) would make two orders. Not checked live: it is a timing race.

Not checked live (no bearer token).

scenarios.behaviour: POST /api/orders creates the order for the calling user, whatever user id the body carries.
scenarios.sourceNote: Suspected eShop bug. Every read takes the buyer from the caller's token (src/Ordering.API/Apis/OrdersApi.cs:95), but create uses request.UserId from the body (OrdersApi.cs:141; CreateOrderCommandHandler.cs:132,140), so a caller could place an order in another user's name and empty their bag (OrderStartedIntegrationEvent). Not checked live (no bearer token).

scenarios.behaviour: A placed order for items in stock moves on its own from 'Submitted' to 'Paid' within a few minutes.
scenarios.sourceNote: Grace period 1 minute, checked every 30 s (src/OrderProcessor/appsettings.json, src/OrderProcessor/Services/GracePeriodManagerService.cs:43-62); stock check src/Catalog.API/IntegrationEvents/EventHandling/OrderStatusChangedToAwaitingValidationIntegrationEventHandler.cs:15-32; payment src/PaymentProcessor/IntegrationEvents/EventHandling/OrderStatusChangedToStockConfirmedIntegrationEventHandler.cs:21-28 (PaymentSucceeded true); transitions src/Ordering.Domain/AggregatesModel/OrderAggregate/Order.cs:99-128. Seen live 2026-11-27: Submitted until about 61-76 s, AwaitingValidation at 76 s, Paid by 91 s; StockConfirmed passed between two 15 s samples, so the row doesn't promise each step is visible.
